latent_estimand: rg of measurement-independent biological sleep with disease: not identified without external information and restrictive validated model
uncertainty: g^T V g, including every variance/covariance cross term; or properly paired nonlinear joint deletions
pair_specific_denominators: Augment theta with both disease variance estimates; a shared disease file does not imply one fitted denominator

current_evidence.counts_scope: inherited dated V4 reports; not a new census or outcome recomputation

requirements.needed: Exact source/release, transformation, direction, covariates, ancestry, time window and disease endpoint for each primary variable
requirements.why: A source-defined contrast is different from a measurement-only effect; rank-normalization/thresholds are not simple reliability changes

requirements.needed: Compatible common-SNP/LD/population target and declared transport assumptions
requirements.why: A shared reference does not identify population transport or remove selection

requirements.needed: A small coherent joint raw S and V, ordered entries and covariance units, or joint vector retaining all pair-specific denominators
requirements.why: Marginal rg tables and fixed-scale V_Stand lack required denominator/cross-fit uncertainty

requirements.needed: Source-bound joint deletion events with per-fit SNP/mask/order mapping; declared intercept, weight and normalization treatment
requirements.why: Equal vector length and marginal SE identity do not prove alignment

requirements.needed: Appropriate LD-block balance/dependence, matrix rank and marginal/joint uncertainty validation for selected estimator/data regime
requirements.why: Rank(V)<=B-1; controllers and invented fixtures are not empirical calibration

requirements.needed: Prespecified handling of weak/nonpositive h2 and nonregular bounds; no favorable deletion or smoothing rescue
requirements.why: Near-zero genetic variances make correlation weakly identified or undefined; general confidence inversion is an established baseline

requirements.needed: Consistent supplied N/N_eff/sample prevalence/population prevalence and observed/liability scale conventions
requirements.why: Positive coherent rescaling leaves rg invariant but absolute liability h2 and ascertainment claims require further assumptions

requirements.needed: Actual participant-overlap documentation or modeled sensitivity and all relevant source intersections
requirements.why: An intercept identifies an overlap-correlation/confounding composite, not shared people or independent replication

requirements.needed: Matched cohort-by-measurement bridge or explicit source-specific interpretation
requirements.why: Measurement and cohort contrasts are confounded when only diagonal design cells exist

requirements.needed: Gold-standard/genotyped calibration, informative repeated measures or justified latent loading/residual constraints
requirements.why: Classical error leaves rg invariant; unrestricted genetic errors admit observationally identical latent worlds

requirements.needed: Frozen finite primary contrast family, selection accounting, effect/equivalence margin, power and negative controls
requirements.why: Historical selected positives and unchanged old BH families do not control a new comparison family

requirements.needed: Appropriately independent source/phenotype validation with power and explicit validation class
requirements.why: Source reuse remains dependence even when an outcome cohort changes; feasibility h2 is not replication

requirements.needed: Source rights and documented permissible access/reuse for actual primary inputs
requirements.why: Statistical identifiability does not establish access or sharing rights

requirements.needed: Null/coverage evidence at claimed tail range and distinct inferential improvement over strong existing baselines before any new-method campaign
requirements.why: Nominal calibration cannot certify extreme tails; delta/jackknife repair is not novelty

potentially_testable: source/definition-specific difference of common-SNP rg with valid joint uncertainty
prespecified equivalence margin if sufficiently precise
descriptive source-specific robustness with qualified validation
not_identified_or_not_certified: latent true biological sleep rg without anchors/constraints
measurement-only effect with confounded cohort design
actual overlap count or zero overlap from an LDSC intercept
causal mechanism from a correlation contrast
fully independent replication from historical sleep reuse
universal transportability from cohort names or reference identity

candidate_decisions.reason: Established multivariable LDSC S,V plus full Jacobian/sandwich or aligned joint jackknife; actual input validity still gated
Classical error needs no rg correction; general genetic measurement error is unidentified; relative dilution prior art exists
Missing crossed measurements/selection anchors; existing observed source contrasts are narrower
Genuine nonregularity, established ratio/profile/confidence-projection principles and existing likelihood baselines; cannot overcome zero variance identification

prohibited_credit: V4 array indices as cross-fit genomic alignment
invented/reference/controller controls as actual GWAS covariance
PSD or nonfinite fallback as scientific admission
source feasibility h2 as new rg or replication
